From the owner
Take a walk with us through this Ravena, NY log cabin renovation! The original space was full of charm, but the homeowners wanted a little modern love. Notice how we paired the natural beauty of new Hickory floors and upper cabinets with rich navy-blue Tedd Wood Fine Cabinetry luxury base cabinets. That bold blue carried upward in the custom herringbone backsplash and even in the customized electrical plate covers—small details that make a big impact. Compliments all around to Project Manager George Griffin, Designers Sarah McDonald & Sarah Domery, and our crew, Dave Clark & Matthew Beckwith! Dave and Matt's problem-solving helped us work around height and weight restrictions. Read the full story of this space on our website.
